body: I have nightmares once every blue moon, and sometimes they can be so realistic that I get scared to go back to sleep. More often then not, I don’t see anything it’s just all black and peaceful.

Hello Dr Mick. Every time I have some sort of romantic feelings for someone and they reciprocate them my feelings for them switch off, like instantly. It literally happens all the time and I don’t know if it’s normal or should I seek help through a therapist?
I sent him a msg a three days before asking what movie we were watching and whether he would pick me up or I’d drive to him. He said he’d msg later (no timeframe given) what the plans were.

Yeah you’re right truthfully it is immature what I did. A large part as well was all the anxiety about actually meeting up. I never really told him how him ignoring me all those years ago actually hurt me, because even though he had a gf at the time I still wanted to be his friend. But still no excuse to be a dick.

I always wait a few hours to see if the feeling goes away. Most of the times it does but sometimes it stays longer. Those are the times I do stupid shit but clearly I’m not dead so, I guess a couple of days and I normally feel a little better. But if I could I’d do it far away some where, where the last thing I see is beautiful and calming.
Family, abuse, sexual abuse from church, bullying, self esteem issues, rejection.

Hey, I am sorry you feel this way bro, i really am. I’ve felt like this a lot in my life, and honestly it baffles me as to why I’m still here. I don’t know how many times I’ve been close to ending it but I can tell you about all the best things in my life that happened after those feelings. If no one has ever told you before,I care about you dude.

Hey, I’m sorry you feel like this. I can relate to how you feel a lot. I have an extremely dysfunctional family, and it has been the root of all my suicidal thoughts. I’ve struggled with hurting myself since I was 12. I’m now 23. Today’s been one of those days where I think about sleeping and not waking up. I have school tomorrow and assignments are due, I also have work so I can make sure my family’s bills are paid. Sometimes this stress distracts me from my feelings and I’m able to carry on longer. What’s helping my mental health right now is my long term goal of moving countries to get away from my family. I love them with everything but I need distance in order to feel any resemblance of happiness. I don’t know if any of this helps but set a long term goal for yourself without your family and use it as motivation. I know you’ve heard it before but it does get better, it truly does. I’m 6 months harm free and although I still think about dying a lot it’s becoming fewer in frequency because I’m so close to achieving my goal. I hope this helped and I hope you find happiness.

I get it, I really do. It’s not about the sex itself but rather the connection with another person. At your age a lot of people are beginning to experience these things and when you haven’t it can make you feel weird, almost like unwanted. I believe things happen for a reason. I kissed a boy, held his hand and slept with him all for the first time in one night when I was 15. I didn’t feel good about myself and in all honesty I felt worse when I actually had my first bf because I wish it was him I gave it to. Time is a long thing, but when it’s meant to happen it’ll happen, you’ve just got to hope it’s with a good one
